## Summary

Lands the **E3 (TypeScript) foreign implementation** of
`hh-xcheck-bundle/1`, part 1 (R4.4): the shared `lib/` core (`hh-json/1`
canonical codec, `idp/1` ids, blob addressing, `identify_text`, tree/1
Merkelized docs) plus five replay arms — identity-trees,
identity-records, ledger-transcript, registry-snapshot, canonical-parse —
running under **node type-stripping, stdlib only, no npm deps, no build
step**. `node foreign/e3-typescript/foreign.ts` writes `answers.json`;
`hh-xcheck verify` reports **35 passed / 22 failed** — every covered case
green, and the 22 FAILs are exactly the R4.4a-owned arms failing honestly
as `missing answer` (never a fabricated or vacuous pass). Evidence class:
`foreign-run-verified` (the PR #136 precedent — below the in-tree
fixture-verified ceiling, never conflated).

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/153_R4.4__e3-typescript-foreign-impl.md`
(seq 153, round 4) · **Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-r4.3`

## What changed

- **`foreign/e3-typescript/lib/core.ts`** — the one shared codec:
  `hh-json/1` canonical JSON (UTF-8-byte-sorted keys, closed escape set,
  integers only; non-integer numbers + unpaired surrogates refused,
  never coerced) + `idp_id`/`address_blob`/`identify_text`/`sha256Hex`
  via `node:crypto`. `identify_text` = `idp_id("hir.text", bytes)`
  verbatim — the current CHECKER.md spelling (the spec-text defect E2
  recorded is resolved in the contract text).
- **`lib/trees.ts`** — manifest → Merkelized doc → `idp_id("tree", …)`;
  **`lib/records.ts`** — blob/text/record answer forms.
- **`lib/ledger.ts`** — `replayWal`: the one `0x00 ‖ canonical(env−hash)
  ‖ prev` fold (R4.4a's `ledger-scenarios` reuses it per case dir);
  frames must already be canonical JSON.
- **`lib/registry.ts`** — `registry.json` replayed into records/
  name-history/revocation/stale-by-dependency projections; the fixed
  corpus output vector (Audit resolves, six pinned Execute selectors,
  `kind=variant` query, three `slot_choices` under
  `contract_version:"1.0"`) folded to `expected-outputs.json`; answer =
  its SHA-256.
- **`lib/canonical_parse.ts`** — decode + re-emit + digest per frame;
  `parse_ns`/`rehash_ns` via `hrtime.bigint()` (recorded, never gated).
- **`foreign.ts`** — driver (`<bundle-dir> <answers.json>`,
  `candidate: "E3-candidate"`); **`answers.json`** — the run's committed
  output; **`README.md`** — toolchain, run commands, per-arm notes,
  discrepancy record, evidence-class statement.
- **`scripts/xcheck-e3.sh`** — the runner R4.5's CI leg reuses: node ≥ 22
  probe → replay → `hh-xcheck verify`; exit 0 iff every FAIL is a
  `missing answer` on an unanswered arm; `skipped(node-absent)` exit 3;
  xcheck binary absent exit 2.
- **`crates/hh-xcheck/tests/r4_4.rs` (4 tests)** — committed-answers
  verify (hermetic: covered arms all `ok`, uncovered only `missing
  answer`), node replay leg (`skipped(node-absent)` honest; fresh answers
  agree with the committed record on every gated member), script
  honest-skip leg, no-npm-deps floor.
- **`docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md`** — dated `Progress 2026-10-21 (R4.4)`
  `foreign-run-verified` notes on DF-S1.2-2 + DF-S1.5-3 + DF-S1.8-1 (all
  stay OPEN — DONE lands per the owning tickets).
- **`docs/build/runs/R4.4.md`** — the run ledger.

`foreign/e2-python` and the bundle contract are **untouched** (main's
landed evidence tree; the E3 tree is new).

## Design decisions

- `lib/` is the ticket's owned shared decision: **one** canonical
  codec/id layer; R4.4a imports it, never re-implements (CC1).
- `Object.create(null)` for reconstructed objects + in-place validation —
  the `__proto__` prototype-setter hazard would silently drop a member
  (honest-refusal class, closed in review).
- `versionCmp` mirrors Python list-compare (prefix-equal shorter vector
  is smaller) and `snapshot` partitions name keys on the first `/` —
  faithful ports of the e2-proven fold.
- The verify FAIL set *is* the part-1 boundary: `xcheck-e3.sh` reconciles
  `missing answer` on unanswered arms (expected pending) vs anything else
  (real failure).
